Does Brad Pitt die in Friends?

He plays Will Colbert, a supporting role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Storms out of Thanksgiving still hating Rachel Green.

Ross's formerly-fat high-school friend Will comes to Monica's Thanksgiving and reveals he and Ross co-founded the 'I Hate Rachel Green Club' and spread a nasty rumor about her. The episode ends with Will, Ross and Rachel bickering and everyone alive.

Pitt and Jennifer Aniston were married at the time. Emmy-nominated guest turn.
